description: Bitget has introduced its Open Custody Network (OCN), allowing eligible users to trade on its spot, margin, and futures markets without transferring assets into the exchange’s custody. The system connects independent banks and custodians to Bitget’s trading engine through asset mirroring, allowing participants to access the exchange’s liquidity while retaining custody of their funds. The initiative targets institutional participants, including market makers and asset managers, and builds on Bitget’s existing partnerships with third-party custody providers.
title: Bitget Launches Open Custody Network for Trading Without Exchange Custody

description: Motorola Signature 27 has been launched in select global markets, the company announced on Thursday. The smartphone is scheduled to go on sale globally soon via the company’s website. It is offered in Pantone Capulet Olive and Pantone Coal Smoke colour options. The phone is powered by an octa-core Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset, which is Qualcomm’s flagship mobile platform built on a 2nm process. It delivers a peak clock speed of up to 5.01GHz. The Motorola Signature 27 is also equipped with a 200-megapixel periscope telephoto camera.
title: Motorola Signature 27 Launched With Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 Chipset: Price, Specifications

description: WhatsApp is reportedly working on a feature that will let users preview a chat without opening it. This upcoming update could allow users to read the latest messages in the preview without opening the chat. The iOS app already offers this experience. The chat preview feature is currently under development and is not yet available for beta testing.
title: WhatsApp for Android Could Soon Let You Preview Chats Without Opening Them

description: Zomato's new Limitless Delivery feature gives users access to restaurants located much farther from their delivery addresses, with orders possible from up to 40km away within the same city. The feature is available in Bengaluru, Delhi NCR, Chennai, Mumbai, Kolkata, Pune and Hyderabad. Users can browse eligible restaurants through a dedicated section on the app or search for them directly. Zomato has also rolled out Host Mode, which hides menu and cart prices while guests add items to a group order.
title: Zomato Rolls Out Limitless Delivery in Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Kolkata, More Indian Cities

description: Oppo Reno 17 series will be launched in China on November 9, the company has announced. The company will also unveil its next-generation tablet, namely the Oppo Pad Air 6, and smartwatch, dubbed Oppo Watch 5. The lineup is expected to comprise the Oppo Reno 17 and Oppo Reno 17 Pro. The lineup is currently available for pre-order in China via the Oppo online store. The company has already teased that the Oppo Reno 17 series will sport a flat rear panel and a flat display. The power button will be placed on the right side of the handsets, along with the volume controls. Meanwhile, the left side could be left clean. Recently, a report highlighted that the standard model will sport a 6.5-inch display, and the Oppo Reno 17 Pro will be equipped with a 6.3-inch touchscreen.
title: Oppo Reno 17 Series Launch Date Announced; Set to Arrive Alongside Oppo Pad Air 6, Watch 5

description: The XRP Ledger has activated a protocol amendment called fixCleanup3_4_0 to address a permission-related vulnerability that could allow accounts authorised to burn tokens to create new ones under specific circumstances. The flaw affected delegated PaymentBurn transactions involving issued assets, including stablecoins and other tokens. The patch prevents transactions from crossing a zero-balance boundary. XRP itself was not affected, and there have been no reported cases of the vulnerability being exploited.
title: XRP Ledger Patches Bug That Threatened Token Minting Security

description: The Vivo V80 marks a significant price jump for Vivo's camera-focused V series. It brings an attractive orange finish, a sharp display, a useful telephoto camera, and excellent battery life. However, its chip feels familiar for the price, and the ultra-wide camera struggles to impress. The biggest frustration is the sluggish camera app. It is a good everyday phone, but not an easy recommendation at Rs. 62,999.
title: Vivo V80 Review: A Camera Phone That Takes Its Time

description: Oppo is expected to launch a smartphone with a 12,000mAh battery, as the handset has been spotted on the MIIT certification website, according to a report. If this is true, the upcoming handset could replace the Oppo A7 Pro Max as Oppo’s phone with the largest battery. The handset was launched in multiple countries outside China in September at a starting price of EUR 599 (roughly Rs. 61,000) for the base 6GB + 256GB RAM and storage configuration. The phone boasts a 10,000mAh battery and supports 80W wired fast charging. It is powered by an octa-core Snapdragon 4 Gen 5 chipset from Qualcomm, along with an Adreno 629 GPU, up to 8GB of LPDDR4x RAM, and 256GB of UFS 3.1 onboard storage.
title: Oppo to Launch a Phone With Massive 12,000mAh Battery: Report

description: Vivo X500 series and a new smartwatch will be launched in India soon, the company has announced. The dedicated microsites for the upcoming Vivo X500 series and smartwatch are now live in the country, confirming that the devices will be available for purchase in India via Amazon and Flipkart. The marketing poster shows the Vivo X500 Pro Max in an orange shade. The phone is expected to feature the same specifications as its global counterpart. It will also get a circular rear camera module, housing a Zeiss-tuned triple camera system. The power button and volume controls will be placed on the right side of the phone, while an unspecified physical button will be placed on its left side.
title: Vivo X500 Series India Launch Confirmed, Smartwatch and Telephoto Lens to Tag Along

description: Oppo on Thursday announced the ColorOS 17 rollout timeline for November. The company has outlined when eligible Oppo, OnePlus, and Realme smartphones and tablets are expected to receive the latest Android 17-based software update. According to Oppo, the rollout will begin today (November 5), with models from all three brands included in the first wave. The November schedule includes the Reno 15 series, OnePlus flagship phones and tablets, and multiple Realme GT, Number, and P series handsets.
title: ColorOS 17 Release Schedule for November: Check Eligible Oppo, OnePlus, Realme Devices

description: OpenAI's latest image generation update adds GIF creation and more editing options to ChatGPT. Users can animate uploaded photos or generate GIFs from text prompts, adjust playback speeds and edit individual frames. The update also lets them save reference images of people, pets and characters for reuse. On the developer side, OpenAI has introduced GPT-Image-2.6 Flare and Sunburst, which promise faster image generation. The API also gets image markup, SVG exports and a new complexity control for image generation.
title: OpenAI Introduces Images 2.6 With GIF Support and Faster API Models

description: Xbox has announced two new controller options in preview for Xbox Cloud Gaming. Users can now connect their Android and iOS smartphones as a controller for the Xbox Cloud Gaming experience on supported smart TVs. Additionally, users in the US can now directly connect the Xbox Nano controller to the smart TV using WiFi instead of Bluetooth.
title: Xbox Cloud Gaming Now Lets You Connect Your Phone as a Controller on Smart TVs
OPPO K14 Plus Overview: A Long-Lasting All-Rounder Worth Considering Under INR 35,000

description: After receiving approval from the US Food and Drug Administration last summer, Samsung has now managed an approval for its Galaxy Buds hearing aids features in South Korea. The approval from the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety means Samsung can roll out the two features on supported TWS earphones.
title: Samsung’s Hearing Aid Features Are Coming to Galaxy Buds 4 Pro and Buds 3 Pro Early Next Year

description: French banking group Crédit Mutuel Arkéa has confirmed a major security breach involving fraudulent transfers estimated at EUR 118 million. The attackers reportedly accessed the bank through an external service provider’s portal before moving funds to other financial institutions, where some money may have been converted into cryptocurrency. The bank said the transactions involved its own account rather than customer accounts. Some funds have been frozen, while authorities continue investigating the losses and potential recovery.
title: French Bank Crédit Mutuel Arkéa Faces EUR 118 Million Hack, With Funds Possibly Moved Into Crypto

description: The iQOO 16 has reportedly received certification from Indonesia's SDPPI, hinting at an upcoming launch in the global markets. The smartphone, which carries the model number I2607, is listed under PT Vivo Mobile Indonesia on the certification platform.  iQOO 16 was launched in China with a 6.85-inch AMOLED display. It runs on a Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset. The Chinese variant has an 8,400mAh battery.
title: iQOO 16 Reportedly Gets SDPPI Certification Ahead of Expected Global Launch

description: WhatsApp is said to be testing a new AI-powered feature for iPhone. According to a feature tracker, it may let users expand photos directly within the messaging app before sharing them. The functionality reportedly leverages Meta AI, the company’s AI assistant, to generate additional content around an existing image and convert it into a vertical 9:16 format. The report claims that it will also make it easier to share landscape and square photos in a full-screen format as WhatsApp Status updates.
title: WhatsApp Reportedly Testing Meta AI-Powered Image Expansion Feature for iPhone

description: A new leak has shed light on the hardware expected on the iQOO Z12 Lite 5G, including its chipset, battery capacity, charging speed and software. The handset could also use the iQOO Z12 SE 5G name in some markets. Its model number has appeared on the IMEI database and Bluetooth SIG certification website, while earlier reports have pointed to its display and camera specifications. The phone is expected to follow the iQOO Z11 Lite 5G, which launched in India in July.
title: iQOO Z12 Lite 5G Specifications Leaked, Could Launch as iQOO Z12 SE 5G

description: Asus Zenbook 14 was launched in India on Thursday. The laptop is offered with Intel Core Ultra, AMD Ryzen AI, and Snapdragon X processors, depending on the variant. It sports a 3K 120Hz OLED touchscreen and a claimed NPU performance of up to 50 TOPS. Asus says the Zenbook 14’s 70Wh battery can deliver up to 33 hours of usage on a single charge. Alongside the laptop, the company has introduced the ZenMouse MD202, which features a Ceraluminum top cover and multi-device connectivity.
title: Asus Zenbook 14 (2026) Launched in India With Intel, AMD and Snapdragon Chips, Up to 33-Hour Battery Life

description: Reddit is testing advertisements within search results, with the initial trial involving a select group of eligible advertisers. The ads will be matched to search queries, so users looking for products could see related promotions alongside results. The platform will study user responses before deciding how to develop the placements further. Separately, Reddit is preparing to require users to sign in to access most of its content. The company says the change will also help address unauthorised data scraping.
title: Reddit Search Results May Soon Show Ads for Products Users Are Looking For

description: Initially revealed as the 'Galaxy Buds Canal 5', Samsung’s ear-hook type workout earbuds have now visited the US’ FCC for certification. While Samsung hasn’t revealed much in its FCC listing, we now have details about its wireless range, Bluetooth capability and idea about its design.
title: Samsung Galaxy Buds T1 Fitness Earbuds Receive FCC Certification Ahead of Expected 2027 Launch

description: An Oppo executive has reportedly confirmed the company's plans to introduce the next-generation foldable in Europe. The Find N7 will arrive as a successor to the Find N6, which debuted in March 2026. The upcoming handset is expected to feature a wider foldable design and could mark the company's first Find N-series smartphone to arrive in the European market.
title: Oppo Executive Says Find N7 Foldable Phone Will Launch in Europe: Report

description: Apple is charging more than three times its cost for the iPhone 18 Pro storage upgrade, according to a report. According to the report, the 1TB storage upgrade used to cost Apple $42 (roughly Rs. 4,000) for the iPhone 17 Pro, which has now gone up to $192 (about Rs. 18,000) for the iPhone 18 Pro. With the costs, the company has also increased its gross profit from $358 (roughly Rs. 34,000) to $408 (about Rs. 39,000). For the lower-end 512GB storage upgrade, Apple used to pay its suppliers $15 (roughly Rs. 1,400), while charging $200 (about Rs. 19,000) to iPhone 17 Pro customers. This cost has also ballooned to $66 (about Rs. 6,000), shrinking its gross profit on the iPhone 18 Pro.
title: Apple Charges More Than Three Times Its Cost for iPhone 18 Pro Storage Upgrade: Report

description: Bitcoin climbed above $80,000 following the US midterm elections, with improving investor sentiment supporting a broader rally across cryptocurrency and equity markets. The move triggered approximately $330 million in short liquidations within an hour. Market participants are now monitoring institutional investment flows, the Federal Reserve’s December policy outlook and developments surrounding the CLARITY Act for signs of a sustained recovery.
title: Bitcoin Reclaims $80,000 as US Midterm Election Results Trigger Crypto Market Rally

description: The Redmi Turbo 6 Max has been rumoured to be in development as the successor to the Turbo 5 Max. While the Xiaomi sub-brand has yet to confirm the handset, a tipster has shed light on some of its key specifications. Traditionally, Xiaomi’s Redmi Turbo lineup has focused on performance, but the purported handset could place just as much emphasis on battery life. It is tipped to pack a battery exceeding 10,000mAh in capacity, which could potentially set a new record for a Xiaomi smartphone.
title: Redmi Turbo 6 Max Tipped to Pack Xiaomi's Biggest Smartphone Battery Yet at 11,000mAh

description: Santa Monica Studio has delayed God of War Laufey by three months. The action-adventure title was set to launch on February 16, 2027. It will now release on May 20. Santa Monica said it would take the additional development time to put "finishing touches" on the game and push it to its "fullest potential".
title: God of War Laufey Delayed by 3 Months as Santa Monica Seeks More Time to Put 'Finishing Touches'

description: Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra will run on the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset, according to a new listing on the NBD trade data platform. The database has reportedly revealed chipset details for all four models in the anticipated Samsung Galaxy S27 series, suggesting that the company could continue using different processors across models and regions.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra Tipped to Feature Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6, NBD Listing Reveals

description: The Xiaomi Mijia Electric Toothbrush 2 Pro has gone on sale in China through a crowdfunding campaign, with an introductory price lower than its regular retail price. It has a handle-mounted colour screen that displays brushing coverage, along with alerts for missed areas and incorrect pressure. The toothbrush also gets a redesigned brush head, multiple vibration patterns and automatic adjustments when users press too hard. Xiaomi says its battery can last up to 190 days, while a full charge takes around six hours.
title: Xiaomi's Mijia Electric Toothbrush 2 Pro Launched With Colour Screen, IPX8 Rating: Price, Features

description: Nothing will launch its first “AI-native product” in December, the company Founder and Chief Executive Officer announced in an article published on X. Pei revealed that the device will sport a screen-free design. The image shared by the Nothing executive gives a glimpse of the upcoming AI hardware. It is shown to feature rounded corners and a textured frame. However, the image does not reveal what category of AI-native device the tech firm is planning to launch. However, the Nothing CEO highlighted that the new AI-native device could not have been an app or feature a new screen.
title: Nothing Teases Launch of Its First ‘AI-Native’ Device With a Screenless Design, as Carl Pei Maps Evolution of Consumer Tech

description: The foldable smartphone market is now evolving, with wide-fold handsets now making their way to the market. Samsung introduced its first wide-fold this year in the form of the Galaxy Z Fold 8, while the iPhone Duo is Apple’s first-ever foldable offering. Xiaomi has introduced the Xiaomi 18 Wide Fold as well. According to a tipster, the Chinese company is exploring a wide-screen slab phone that would offer a similar form factor to its wide fold, but without a folding mechanism.
title: Xiaomi Tipped to be Developing a Wide-Screen Slab Phone Inspired by Xiaomi 18 Fold

description: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake has now become the highest rated game of 2026. With reviews coming out a day before launch, the remake is sitting at an aggregate Metacritic score of 96, based on 84 reviews. The rating makes the game the best reviewed title in years and the highest rated game since Baldur's Gate 3 in 2023.
title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake Becomes Highest Rated Game Since Baldur's Gate 3

description: Google has reportedly expanded its voluntary exit packages to some employees in five countries. This would include countries like Canada, France, Germany, Japan and Switzerland. The search giant’s expanding severance programme comes amid rising costs on artificial intelligence spending.
title: Google Expands Voluntary Buyout Programme to Five Countries Amid Heavy Spending on Artificial Intelligence

description: HP has named Emma Walmsley as its new CEO, the company announced on Wednesday. The computer-solutions company says that Walmsley will take the reins of HP on January 4, 2027. Walmsley currently serves as an Independent Director on Microsoft's Board. She will take over the responsibilities from Bruce Broussard, who is currently serving as the Interim CEO of HP. Broussard has remained in the position since February 2026. The company executive will transition into a new role, HP announced. Walmsley will charge as the company’s third full-time woman CEO. HP has previously had two full-time women CEOs and one interim woman CEO. Carly Fiorina served as the company’s first woman CEO, taking charge on July 19, 1999, and serving till February 9, 2005. Meg Whitman became the second full-time woman CEO of the US-based tech giant on September 22, 2011, serving in the role for slightly over four years, till November 2, 2015.
title: HP Appoints Emma Walmsley as Its Next CEO; Will Succeed Current Interim CEO Bruce Broussard in January 2027

description: Google Photos is set to introduce a change to its bin retention policy, reducing the period for which deleted photos and videos are stored from 60 days to 30 days. The updated policy will take effect on December 5, 2026. Additionally, an APK teardown of the Google Photos app suggests that it could soon let users create calendar events from posters and flyers using Ask Photos. The feature may support Android's default calendar app.
title: Google Photos to Cut Bin Retention Period to 30 Days; May Soon Let Users Create Calendar Events From Posters

description: Reliance Jio has introduced a new prepaid data pack in India. The telecom service provider says its new recharge option is aimed at subscribers who need additional data for activities such as 4K video streaming, online gaming, large downloads, and remote work. It is priced at Rs. 15 and provides 24 hours of unlimited high-speed 5G data. Unlike regular data add-ons with a fixed data allowance, the pack is advertised as offering truly unlimited 5G connectivity for its validity period.
title: Jio Rolls Out Rs. 15 Unlimited 5G Data Pack With 24-Hour Validity for Streaming, Gaming and Downloads
